# Texas Electrical Contractors LLC

> Full-service MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) contractor serving El Paso, Texas and surrounding regions with commercial and industrial solutions.

Texas Electrical Contractors LLC is a comprehensive MEP contracting firm based in El Paso, Texas, offering integrated mechanical, electrical, and plumbing services for commercial and industrial clients. The company operates under multiple licensed entities including Texas Electrical Master's License, Texas Plumbing Contractors LLC, and Texas Mechanical Contractors LLC.

## Core Services

- [Electrical Services](https://texas-mep.com/electrical): Commercial electrical installation, repair, and maintenance services in El Paso and New Mexico.
- [Mechanical Services](https://texas-mep.com/mechanical): Mechanical and HVAC services offered for commercial and industrial clients.
- [Plumbing Services](https://texas-mep.com/plumbing): Commercial plumbing services including repairs, installation, and drain cleaning in El Paso.
